info.noServers: no servers are listed, so clients cannot tell where the API is served
info.noHost: no host is set, so clients cannot tell where the API is served
info.httpOnly: the API is offered over http only

operations.noSummary: the operation has neither a summary nor a description
operations.undeclaredTag: tag "{{tag}}" is not declared in the top-level tags
operations.deprecatedWithoutDescription: the operation is deprecated but has no description saying what to use instead
operations.noSecurity: the spec defines security schemes but this operation requires none

paths.noLeadingSlash: path "{{path}}" does not start with a slash
paths.parameterUndeclared: path parameter "{{name}}" is in the path but not declared
paths.parameterUnused: path parameter "{{name}}" is declared but not in the path

responses.noError: the operation declares neither a default nor a 4xx response
responses.bodyOnRead: {{method}} operations should not have a request body
responses.noBodyExample: the {{media}} request body has no example

security.undefinedScheme: security scheme "{{name}}" is used but not defined
